## Summary
What product behavior, code, or documentation changed?

## Validation
- [ ] Typecheck/build run locally and logs attached
- [ ] Keyboard focus and mobile UX checked
- [ ] Reduced-motion behavior checked
- [ ] Privacy and testnet disclosure remains accurate
- [ ] No real wallet secrets, witness inputs or user private data introduced
- [ ] Cross-repo interface changes documented and pinned

## Screenshot / proof
Include desktop and mobile previews for visible UI changes; or explain why unavailable.

## Scope
Mark features explicitly as proposed, demo, verified on testnet, or audited.
